# Composition Science Ontology v1

## Purpose

Canonical vocabulary for the Composition Science project.

## Root Genome Nodes

### GN-000 Human Systems

-   GN-100 Perception
-   GN-200 Cognition
-   GN-300 Action
-   GN-400 Emotion

### GN-500 Composition

-   GN-510 Spatial Organization
-   GN-520 Hierarchy
-   GN-530 Visual Encoding
-   GN-540 Structure
-   GN-550 Navigation
-   GN-560 Interaction

## Example Node

### GN-510 Spatial Organization

Definition: How spatial relationships communicate organization.

Children: - GN-511 Proximity - GN-512 Separation - GN-513 Density -
GN-514 Alignment - GN-515 Enclosure - GN-516 Connectedness

Measured Variables: - center-to-center distance - edge-to-edge
distance - spacing ratio - eccentricity

Related Laws: - LAW-001 - LAW-013

## Relationship Graph

Perception → Attention → Grouping → Hierarchy → Navigation → Decision
Making

## ID Standards

-   GN = Genome Node
-   LAW = Candidate Law
-   EVD = Evidence
-   EXP = Experiment
-   OBS = Observation
-   MET = Metric
-   CASE = Case Study
-   GOV = Governance
-   ONT = Ontology
